comment: Language ownership — the IDE-neutral authority for which tool owns which language
in a governed workspace. Deliberately contains no extension IDs and no editor.* keys:
those are rendering, and live in render.cursor.json (Cursor) or in an adapter under
ops/scripts/adapters/. Every adapter renders THIS file; none of them decides ownership.
Workspace classification (which class a repo belongs to) lives in exceptions.yaml.

authority_values.governance: This profile declares the concrete binding — the adapter renders it.
authority_values.repo: The repo's own config decides. Adapters MUST NOT bind a formatter for these languages, or they would fight the project config. This is formatter exclusivity.

biome_default.description: Default for every governed workspace: Biome owns JS/TS/JSON, Ruff owns Python.

eslint_owned.description: Workspaces where ESLint/Prettier config in the repo is authoritative for JS/TS. Python is still Ruff-owned.
